## NullValue class

[Value](docs/obsidian_docs/obsidian_dev_docs/en/Reference/TypeScript%20API/Value.md) which represents null. NullValue is a singleton and `NullValue.value` should be used instead of calling the constructor.

 1.10.0

**Signature:**

```typescript
export class NullValue extends Value 
```
